directionContract.thesis: Local clinical PDF filling as a controlled intake workbench, refusing a marketing dashboard or cloud workflow.
directionContract.ownWorld: Pale workstation surfaces, ink text, teal controls, red safety accent, thin dividers, compact rails, form rows.
directionContract.story: Clinician selects a demo form, enters data, reviews it, generates a browser-only PDF, and clears state.
directionContract.firstViewport: Header and privacy strip above a two-column workbench with section rail, active form, and visible primary action.

componentNotes.buttons: Icon plus text, 7px radius, 44px minimum height. Primary uses teal fill and white text.
componentNotes.forms: One-column by default, bordered controls, row-style checkbox/radio choices, visible field errors.
componentNotes.sectionRail: Sticky desktop rail, stacked tablet/mobile rail, active state in soft teal.
componentNotes.templatePreview: Static PNG rendered from the active PDF, with a direct PDF link overlaid.

notCanonized: Browser PDF-plugin preview fallback is not part of the system; the shipped UI uses a generated PNG preview instead.
